tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Opened the app; dialog "Erste Einrichtung: Bahn 1 kalibrieren" appeared. Clicked "Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt", waited 20 seconds and took a new snapshot. The dialog was still titled "Erste Einrichtung: Bahn 1 kalibrieren" and read "Bahn 1 wird kalibriert … bitte warten." Bahn 1 showed "Geschwindigkeit: 60 (35 cm/s)", so calibration had started, but after 20 seconds the dialog had not advanced to Bahn 2 and nothing asked to place Bahn 2 on the calibration point.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes.
Observed failure: The 24-action budget ran out after two of the four 8-second screenshots. Setup worked (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 1 -> Haltestelle 2; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 2 -> Haltestelle 1; Start). Screenshot 1 (8 s): Bahn 1 on the top straight, Bahn 2 on the spur to the Kalibrierpunkt, no overlap. Screenshot 2 (16 s): Bahn 1 at Haltestelle 1, Bahn 2 at Haltestelle 2, no overlap. The head-on passing phase (next leg A->B / B->A) was not observed, so waiting or evading was not confirmed.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Setup as specified (A = Haltestelle 1, B = Haltestelle 2 for both trains), Start clicked. At ~2 s 'Bahn 1' was at A; at ~56 s 'Bahn 1' was still at A while 'Bahn 2' was at B; at ~83 s 'Bahn 1' had left A and was on SD1 heading for Haltestelle 2, while 'Bahn 2' had gone on to Haltestelle 1. Within the observation window 'Bahn 1' was never seen at B nor back at A, so its A -> B -> A loop was not shown. The action budget ran out before the last wait/screenshot.
Steps completed before failure: 11
